thread:
Anya: quick midday check — where are we on the rail queue? i see 6 pending merges, two are cherry-picks from the infra-hotfix lane.
Sam: looking now, one cherry-pick (#4823) is blocked on failing smoke test. CI shows a flake in `load-balancer-tests`.
CI-bot: build/4823 — failed on test: lb_integration_test::route_fallback (flake) — re-run recommended: /ci retry 4823
Mike: i retriggered the job, will watch. if it flakes again we should revert the config change and reapply in a canary.
Anya: thanks. which config change? the `max-conns` bump for nginx?
Mike: yep, that one. it reduced tail latency in staging but triggered the flaky route. probably timeout tweak.
Julia: FYI canary is green for the other region, so it's likely timing-sensitive. i can add a short sleep in the test to stabilize, but prefer fixing root cause.
Sam: for the other 5 merges, one needs a quick review from @Anya (docs link update), two are LGTM but need merge queue slot, and one is a straight revert candidate.
Anya: i'll review the docs PR in ~20m. which PR is revert candidate?
Sam: #4819 — it regressed telemetry; was merged last night and surfaced increased error rates in canary. rollout rolled back automatically but we should revert the change in master too.
ReleaseBot: Canary health: region-us-west — 99.2%; region-eu-central — 99.9%; auto-fallback triggered for 1% of requests during the window (related to #4819).
Mike: i'll open a revert PR for #4819 and tag it `urgent/revert-telemetry`. can someone prioritize merging it so we can unblock the rail?
Julia: i can take merge once CI passes. Sam, can you also add a watch on the telemetry dashboard for the next 2 hours?
Sam: on it. i set an alert for error rate > 0.5% above baseline and a paging rule for >1%.
Anya: small ask — can we reserve one queue slot for canary if the revert lands? the merge queue is backed up and we want the revert to get immediate throughput.
ReleaseBot: Merge queue length: 6. Reserved slots: 0.
Mike: i'll bump priority on the revert. if CI flakes again on #4823, we pause that cherry and proceed with the revert.
CI-bot: build/4823 re-run queued by Mike — status: running
Sam: heads-up for release leads: schedule patch window at 1800 UTC if revert is merged and canary stays stable. otherwise hold.
Anya: sounds good. i'll ping folks in 30m with updated queue status. :thumbsup:
Julia: thanks — i'll monitor canary and the flaky test logs. if i see a clear race i'll open a fix PR instead of test hacks.
Mike: update: build/4823 passed on retry. i'm leaving a comment on the PR to gate next attempts behind a short test stabilization.
Anya: perfect. i'll review the docs PR now and get that merged. thanks team.
